headline: Ownership Flux Spikes Across Six Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the heaviest fighting has deepened on six sectors. Weathered Expanse still leads with 41 ownership changes in the past day, adding 9,754 Colonial and 10,428 Warden casualties and 425 fresh enlistments. Mooring County follows with 25 flips, 9,894 Colonial and 10,017 Warden dead and 1,149 new troops arriving — a slight drop from the 31 changes reported earlier. Stlican Shelf records 11 changes centred on Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, raising its toll to 2,379 Colonial and 2,475 Warden losses with 445 enlistments. Palantine Berm also shows 11 flips, driving casualties to 2,201 Colonial and 2,686 Warden while 639 soldiers join the fight. Callahans Passage registers four recent captures, its 24‑hour toll now 8,345 Colonial and 7,359 Warden casualties and 488 enlistments. Nevish Line logs three flips, adding 4,701 Colonial and 3,992 Warden dead and 667 enlistments. Casualty rates are accelerating on all six fronts, while the majority of rear‑area regions remain static with no ownership moves reported.
